description: Single-DAO static IPFS governance dashboard for ENS DAO, powered by Gateful REST API

userStories.title: Strip to single-DAO static shell
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the project restructured as a single-DAO (ENS) static site with no server dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove [daoId] dynamic routing — all pages are flat (/, /token-distribution, /governance, etc.)
Remove home page DAO selector / panel — root / goes directly to ENS overview
All next/image replaced with or unoptimized: true
ENS DAO config hardcoded as the single data source
next build produces out/ directory successfully
userStories.notes: This is the big restructure. Current routing is app/[daoId]/(main)/... and app/[daoId]/(secondary)/... — flatten to app/(main)/... with ENS hardcoded. Remove app/page.tsx home panel, app/aave/, app/alerts/, app/contact/, app/donate/. Keep shared/ and features/ intact for now.

userStories.title: Implement Gateful REST data layer for ENS
userStories.description: As a developer, I need typed data fetching hooks that pull ENS data from the Gateful REST API.
acceptanceCriteria: Create shared/data/gateful-client.ts with typed fetch functions for all ENS endpoints
All response types defined in shared/data/types.ts matching actual Gateful API shapes
Create React hooks (useProposals, useToken, useTreasury, useFeedEvents, useDelegations, etc.) using TanStack Query
Remove Apollo Client, @anticapture/graphql-client dependency, and all graphql imports
NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL env var configures API base URL (default: https://gateful.up.railway.app)
userStories.notes: Gateful REST API at https://gateful.up.railway.app with CORS enabled. TanStack Query is already in package.json. Apollo Client, @apollo/client, graphql, and @anticapture/graphql-client should all be removed. Types should be derived from actual API response samples.

userStories.title: Wire features to new data hooks
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all feature components to use the new Gateful REST hooks instead of Apollo/GraphQL.
acceptanceCriteria: features/dao-overview uses useToken and useTreasury hooks
features/token-distribution uses token supply and compare hooks
features/attack-profitability uses treasury and token price hooks
features/governance uses useProposals and proposal detail hooks
features/holders-and-delegates uses delegation and delegator hooks
features/risk-analysis renders from DAO config (static, no API)
No Apollo imports remain in the codebase
All features render with live data from Gateful
userStories.notes: This is the largest story — touching every feature. Work through features one at a time. risk-analysis and resilience-stages use static config from shared/dao-config/ens.ts so they don't need API changes. The governance feature has both list and detail views. Holders/delegates has drawers with sub-queries.

userStories.title: Fix asset paths and fonts for IPFS
userStories.description: As a user on eth.limo, I need all assets to load correctly from IPFS.
acceptanceCriteria: All static assets use relative paths
Google Fonts replaced with self-hosted Inter in public/fonts/
No hardcoded localhost or domain-specific asset URLs
Built out/ serves correctly via npx serve out
userStories.notes: IPFS gateways serve at varying path depths. Relative paths are safest. next/font may not work with static export — test first, replace with manual font-face if needed.

userStories.title: Remove unused features and cleanup
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to remove dead code, unused features, and multi-DAO artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: PostHog and Umami removed or behind env var
No dead imports or unused components
userStories.notes: PostHog is in shared/services/posthog/, Umami in shared/services/umami/. Either remove entirely or wrap in NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_ANALYTICS check.

userStories.title: Static page generation and routing
userStories.description: As a user, I need clean URLs for each section that work on IPFS.
acceptanceCriteria: /governance/proposal/[proposalId] uses client-side routing for dynamic IDs
All pages pre-rendered as static HTML in out/
userStories.notes: Proposal detail is the only truly dynamic route. Use a catch-all [[...slug]] or generateStaticParams with a placeholder and client-side fetch. All other pages are known at build time.

userStories.title: IPFS deployment script
userStories.description: As a developer, I need one command to build and deploy to IPFS.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/deploy-ipfs.sh builds and pins out/ to IPFS
userStories.notes: CIDv1 base32 needed for ENS content hash. Script should also support Pinata as alternative.

userStories.title: Smoke test and build verification
userStories.description: As a developer, I need automated verification that the static build works.
acceptanceCriteria: Test script builds the project with next build
Verifies out/ contains: index.html, token-distribution/index.html, governance/index.html, _next/static/
Serves out/ locally and checks key pages return 200
Verifies no broken asset references in HTML

userStories.title: README
userStories.description: As a developer, I need docs for the Immutable Vote ENS build.
acceptanceCriteria: README explains: what this is, how to dev locally, how to build, how to deploy to IPFS
Lists all env vars with descriptions
Explains how to create another DAO site from this template
